$comment: Design geometry mapping table (detector system design spec ART-33..ART-35, contracts 3.11.0): the candidate parameters a Geant4 study geometry reads (each field an expression of the tool contract design block, tool_contract.json $defs/expr), and the figures of merit a study record can deliver with their denominators. Read by evaluate_design.py geometry (which writes the geometry file and the digest of the parameters read) and by contracts/design.py (which recomputes that digest, ART-35). Kept in contracts/rules/ (OQ-08, the spec's alternative location): it describes no command-line tool, and every file in contracts/tool_contracts/ is checked against a tool's --help.

tail_sensitive.$comment: FID-03: resolution, confusion rate and rejection stay optimistic unless the study simulated every tail source
